reserved: evaluation only: never used for calibration, cutoff selection, tuning or development; changing any question, fact or quote requires a new version file

questions.text: Do I have to take all of my parental leave in one go?

facts.fact: Parental leave may be one continuous block or split within the first year.
facts.quote: Parental leave may be taken in a single continuous block or split within the first year.

questions.text: Am I protected if I speak up about something I honestly think is wrong at work?

facts.fact: Retaliation against someone who reports a concern in good faith is prohibited.
facts.quote: Retaliation against an employee who reports a concern in good faith is strictly prohibited.

questions.text: What do I need if an illness keeps me out longer than my regular sick allowance?

facts.fact: Medical leave beyond ten days needs written HR approval and a physician's supporting documentation.
facts.quote: Extended medical leave beyond ten days requires written approval from Human Resources and supporting documentation from a physician.

questions.text: If I don't use this month's fitness allowance, can I spend it next month instead?

facts.fact: The wellness stipend does not roll over between months.
facts.quote: The stipend is paid as a reimbursement and does not roll over between months.

questions.text: What am I required to report at work, and who do I report each thing to?

facts.fact: Conflicts of interest are disclosed to the employee's manager.
facts.quote: Employees must disclose any conflicts of interest to their manager as soon as they arise.

facts.fact: Vendor or client gifts over one hundred dollars are reported to compliance.
facts.quote: Gifts from vendors or clients valued over one hundred dollars must be reported to compliance.

facts.fact: Lost badges are reported to security within twenty four hours.
facts.quote: Lost badges must be reported to security within twenty four hours of discovery.

facts.fact: Lost or damaged equipment is reported to IT immediately.
facts.quote: Lost or damaged equipment outside normal wear must be reported to IT immediately.

questions.text: On a work trip, which flights need extra sign-off and which costs need a receipt?

facts.fact: Economy is standard under six hours; business class needs VP approval.
facts.quote: Economy class is standard for flights under six hours; business class requires VP approval.

facts.fact: Receipts are required for any single expense over twenty five dollars.
facts.quote: Receipts are required for any single expense over twenty five dollars.

questions.text: What does the company do on a quarterly schedule?

facts.fact: Parking permits are issued each quarter, first come first served.
facts.quote: Parking permits are issued on a first come first served basis each quarter.

facts.fact: Backup snapshots older than one year are purged quarterly.
facts.quote: Backup snapshots older than one year are purged quarterly.

questions.text: How far ahead do I need to act when reserving a conference room, asking for planned time off, and getting review feedback in?

facts.fact: Meeting rooms can be booked up to two weeks in advance (facilities calendar).
facts.quote: Meeting rooms can be booked up to two weeks in advance through the facilities calendar.

facts.fact: Planned leave requests go through the HR portal at least two weeks in advance.
facts.quote: Leave requests must be submitted through the HR portal at least two weeks in advance for planned absences.

facts.fact: Managers submit written feedback two weeks before the review meeting.
facts.quote: Managers submit written feedback two weeks before the scheduled review meeting.

questions.text: How many days off do employees get for jury duty?
What mileage rate is reimbursed when I drive my own car for business?
Can I work remotely from another country for a few weeks?
How long does the company keep employees' performance review records?

diagnostics.known_issue: credited by score.py while omitting the sick- and parental-leave policies
diagnostics.text: What are all the different kinds of paid time off available to employees?

facts.fact: Employees accrue fifteen days of paid leave per year.
facts.quote: Employees accrue fifteen days of paid leave per year.

facts.fact: Up to ten sick days per year without a doctor's note.
facts.quote: Employees may take up to ten sick days per year without providing a doctor's note.

facts.fact: Primary caregivers receive twelve weeks of paid parental leave.
facts.quote: Primary caregivers receive twelve weeks of paid parental leave following a birth, adoption, or foster placement.

diagnostics.text: Can I get a better chair for my desk?

facts.fact: A standing desk or ergonomic chair can be requested through the facilities portal.
facts.quote: Employees may request a standing desk or an ergonomic chair through the facilities portal.

diagnostics.known_issue: answers an unsupported question with unrelated leave policies
diagnostics.text: How many days of bereavement leave do employees get?
